name: ISO 20022 message-gaming benchmark
description: A seeded synthetic benchmark of eleven message-level manipulations of ISO 20022 pain.001 and pacs.008 records (misfielding, purpose-code substitution, message-path changes) against a transparent screening abstraction with a controlled ordinary-error floor, with cross-fitted detectors, exact alert-capacity metrics, screening-evasion lift, and a verification pipeline that traces every number in the paper to the result files.
